license_required.quote: Any person who practices dentistry without being properly qualified and licensed, or who violates any provisions of this act is subject to a fine

issuing_authority.quote: "Board" means the Wyoming board of dental examiners established by this act

name.quote: "Board" means the Wyoming board of dental examiners established by this act

type.quote: "Board" means the Wyoming board of dental examiners established by this act

moral_character_required.quote: Any person who has a background that does not evidence conduct adverse to the practice of dentistry or to the ability to practice dentistry

degree_required.value: Doctor of Dental Surgery (D.D.S.) or Doctor of Dental Medicine (D.M.D.)
degree_required.quote: who has graduated and attained the degree of doctor of dental surgery or doctor of dental medicine from a college or university in the United States or Canada accredited by the commission on dental accreditation of the American Dental Association

accrediting_body.value: Commission on Dental Accreditation of the American Dental Association
accrediting_body.quote: accredited by the commission on dental accreditation of the American Dental Association

exams.name: Written, clinical, and state examination
exams.notes: Follows national standards as determined by rule of the board
exams.quote: The applicant shall pass a written, clinical and state examination that follows national standards as determined by rule of the board.

interval_years.quote: On or before December 31 of every second year, each dentist licensed to practice dentistry in this state and wishing to continue in the practice of dentistry shall submit a license renewal application

required.quote: The board may set continuing education requirements for renewal certificates and relicensure certificates. The board shall require three (3) hours of continuing education related to the responsible prescribing of controlled substances every two (2) years.

hours_per_period.quote: The board shall require three (3) hours of continuing education related to the responsible prescribing of controlled substances every two (2) years.

period_years.quote: three (3) hours of continuing education related to the responsible prescribing of controlled substances every two (2) years

topical_requirements.quote: three (3) hours of continuing education related to the responsible prescribing of controlled substances every two (2) years

regulatory_model.quote: Any person who practices dentistry without being properly qualified and licensed, or who violates any provisions of this act is subject to a fine

credential_type.quote: may apply to the board to have the applicant's qualifications considered for licensure to practice dentistry

is_mandatory.quote: Any person who practices dentistry without being properly qualified and licensed, or who violates any provisions of this act is subject to a fine not to exceed one thousand dollars ($1,000.00), or imprisonment not more than two (2) years

title_protection.quote: Who uses the words "dentist", "dental surgeon" or "oral surgeon", the letters "D.D.S.", "D.M.D." or any other words, letters, title or descriptive matter which in any way represents him as being able to diagnose, treat, prescribe or operate for any disease, pain, deformity, deficiency, injury or physical condition of human teeth or jaws, or adjacent structures

scope_protection.quote: Any person who practices dentistry without being properly qualified and licensed, or who violates any provisions of this act is subject to a fine

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of, or plea of nolo contendere to, or deferred prosecution agreement for a felony or misdemeanor adversely related to dentistry
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction of, entry of a plea of nolo contendere to or entry of a deferred prosecution agreement pursuant to W.S. 7-13-301 to a felony or misdemeanor that relates adversely to the practice of dentistry or the ability to practice dentistry

disciplinary_grounds.description: Renting or loaning the dentist's license or diploma to another person
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Renting or loaning to another person the dentist's license or diploma to be used as a license or diploma for the other person

disciplinary_grounds.description: Unprofessional conduct as defined in board rules and regulations
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Unprofessional conduct as defined in rules and regulations of the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Advertising or soliciting patients in a false or misleading manner
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Advertising or soliciting patients, in any form of communication, in a manner that is false or misleading in any material respect

disciplinary_grounds.description: Inability to practice with reasonable skill and safety due to physical or mental disability or substance use
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Inability to practice dentistry with reasonable skill and safety because of physical or mental disability or the use of alcohol, prescription drugs, nonprescription drugs or other psychoactive substance

disciplinary_grounds.description: Performance of unsafe dental practice or failure to conform to acceptable professional standards
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Performance of unsafe dental practice or failure to conform to the standards of acceptable professional dental practice, whether or not actual injury results

disciplinary_grounds.description: Professional discipline by a licensing board in any jurisdiction
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Professional discipline by a professional licensing board in any jurisdiction

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraud, deceit or misrepresentation in providing information or records to the board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fraud, deceit or misrepresentation in providing any information or record to the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willful violation of any provision of the act or board rules and regulations
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willful violation of any provisions of this act or rules and regulations of the board

definition_quote.value: the healing art practiced by a dentist which is concerned with the examination, diagnosis, treatment, planning and care of conditions within the human oral cavity and its adjacent tissues and structures
definition_quote.quote: "Dentistry" means the healing art practiced by a dentist which is concerned with the examination, diagnosis, treatment, planning and care of conditions within the human oral cavity and its adjacent tissues and structures

value: care of conditions within the human oral cavity and adjacent tissues and structures
administration of anesthesia in connection with dental operations
methods_authorized.quote: performs any intraoral and extraoral procedure required in the practice of dentistry

drug_authority.value: Dentists have responsibility for prescribing drugs administered to patients in the practice of dentistry
drug_authority.quote: The responsibility for prescribing drugs which are administered to patients in the practice of dentistry

sedation_anesthesia_permit_types.quote: Any dentist licensed under this act who administers general anesthesia or parenteral sedation shall apply for and receive a general anesthesia or parenteral sedation permit.

sedation_permit_onsite_inspection_requir.quote: The board shall provide for the inspection of the anesthesia and sedation equipment of permitted dentists on a regular basis to insure the equipment is of the appropriate type and is in working order.

dental_hygienist_supervision_levels.quote: The above services shall be performed under the supervision of a licensed dentist.

dental_office_ownership_restrictions.quote: "Proprietor" includes any person who: Employs dentists, dental hygienists or dental auxiliaries in the operation of a dental office, except as defined in this act

dental_laboratory_work_authorization_req.quote: Any licensed dentist who employs or engages the service of any person, firm or corporation to construct, reproduce, make, alter or repair bridges, crowns, dentures or other prosthetic, surgical or orthodontic appliances shall furnish the person with a written work authorization on forms prescribed by the board

patient_record_retention_years.quote: shall retain the original work authorization and the dentist shall retain the duplicate copy for inspection at any reasonable time by the board or its authorized agents for two (2) years from date of issuance
